description: Sobo Waterfall is a scenic waterfall located along the Madamas Road near the village of Brasso Seco in Trinidad's Northern Range. It is accessible via a moderate hike making it a rewarding destination for hikers and nature lovers alike. Listed opening hours: 24 HOURS. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
